rules.detects: an exported query, mutation or action built by what a file inside the Convex functions folder imports from _generated/server; an internal function is not one
a route a convex/server httpRouter registers with .route({ path or pathPrefix, method, handler }), its handler named or inline
the function a convex/server cronJobs table runs, named through the generated API by dots or static brackets

entrances.notDetected: a library's routes added with addHttpRoutes, functions built by a custom builder wrapping Convex's, and functions a library such as convexAuth exports are not detected
